N = 16, course band f/f_max in [0.5, 1.0] (5-10 GHz at f_max = 10 GHz); inner beams |k'| <= 6.

## Headline numbers

- Squint spread: PS 60.0 deg, EXACT 1.0e-12 deg, ADVM 1.69 deg
- Max pointing error: PS 60.0 deg, EXACT 6.9e-13 deg, ADVM 1.12 deg
- Worst SLL: EXACT -13.15 dB, ADVM -7.82 dB -> worst SLL delta ADVM vs EXACT 5.32 dB (course band), 7.02 dB (full 0.1-1 sweep)
- ADVM relative spectral-norm error (N=16, over the sweep): 0.249 .. 0.689
- Gain-delay reduction of ADVM: N=16 -> 72.4% vs DIRECT, 52.3% vs EXACT; N=1024 -> 98.5% vs DIRECT, 21.2% vs EXACT (area/power: estimate, proportional model)
- b* (ADVM-b, our extension) = 5 (trivial: b >= log2(2N) = 5 puts every twiddle exactly on the 2^b grid, i.e. ADVM-b == EXACT for N = 16)
